identity.name: Aaron Spears
identity.summary: Church-raised drummer for Usher, Ariana Grande and Justin Bieber, one of the R&B drummers of the gospel-chops generation; died October 2023, aged 47.

contribution.description: One of the drummers Modern Drummer put on its 2009 cover for taking church drumming onto R&B stages: he learned time from his church organist rather than a click, and played Usher and James Brown at the 2005 Grammys.
